recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central group of five to six men in vibrant, patterned 1980s fashion, set against a solid blue field and framed by a complex, multi-colored zigzag border.
coreVisualRelationships: The bold yellow typography anchors the top third of the frame.
The subjects are arranged in a tiered, triangular formation for depth.
The red inner stroke separates the busy border from the clean blue background.
The metallic sheen of the clothing echoes the texture of the outer border.
coreInvariants: Wavy, multi-colored horizontal zigzag border pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body and seated group portrait centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, high-contrast yellow display type at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright yellow text, move down through the central figure, and sweep across the seated figures on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid blue space around the heads of the subjects provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background providing high contrast for the subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for the thin framing line and various jewel tones in the clothing and border.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements, with bright highlights on metallic fabrics.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and elegant script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses heavy, blocky serifs with minimal spacing.
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected cursive script.
Tight kerning creates a unified block of color.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is integrated into the central alignment of the top text block.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, masculine slab serif with a delicate, feminine script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary elegant flourish for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of five men in 1980s patterned silk shirts and metallic trousers, posed in a studio with a solid blue backdrop. Frame the image with a thin red line and a wide outer border featuring a horizontal zigzag pattern in red, silver, and blue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a heavy yellow slab serif font at the top center. Directly underneath, add a subtitle in a white cursive script font.

verificationChecks: Is the zigzag border present on all four sides?
Is there a clear red line separating the border from the blue background?
Is the main text yellow and the subtitle white?
Are the subjects wearing 80s-era patterned clothing?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the group
Specific colors in the zigzag border
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact clothing patterns to avoid direct replication
postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the blue background.
Ensure the red frame is perfectly rectangular.
Verify the zigzag pattern is consistent and rhythmic.
Confirm the lighting on the subjects is bright and even.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Group Portrait] + [Solid Blue Background] + [Zigzag Border] + [Slab Serif/Script Typographic Lockup].
